### MODELS APPLIED TO RICHNESS
```{r}
#### LOAD MODELS #### 
dir <- './HmscOutputs'
pattern <- '2026-03-13'

matching_folders <- list.dirs(dir, recursive = FALSE, full.names = F)
matching_folders <- matching_folders[grepl(pattern,
                                           basename(matching_folders))]
model <- matching_folders[1]
models_nums <- as.numeric(str_extract(matching_folders, "(?<=Atlas)\\d+"))

# load models
mods <- lapply(matching_folders,function(model){
  # read objects
  load(file.path(dir,model,'Models','Fitted','HPC_samples_0250_thin_100_chains_4.Rdata'))
  m <- fitted_model$posteriors
})
names(mods) <- models_nums
#mod <- mods[[1]]
# load designs
designs <- lapply(mods,function(mod){
  mod$studyDesign %>% 
    rownames_to_column(.,var='survey') %>% 
    left_join(.,
              mod$ranLevels$site$s %>% rownames_to_column(.,var='site'),
              by = 'site')
})
# load MFs
MFs <- lapply(matching_folders,function(model){
  # read objects
  load(file.path(dir,
                    model,
                 'Models',
                    'Fitted',
                    'MF_samples_0250_thin_100_chains_4_nfolds_10.rdata'))
  list <- list(MF,MFCV)
  names(list) <- c('MF','MFCV')
  list
})
names(MFs) <- models_nums
str(MFs)

#### GET PREDS #### 
predsY <- map2(mods, matching_folders, function(mod, folder) {
  
  # Define the target file path
  target_path <- file.path(dir, 
                           folder, 
                           'Results', 
                           'Preds', 
                           'predicted-values.rdata')
  
  if (!file.exists(target_path)) {
    # If file doesn't exist, compute predictions
    message(paste("Computing predictions for:", folder))
    
    # Compute full predictions
    pred_temp <- pcomputePredictedValues(mod)
    
    # Calculate row means (predsY logic)
    pred_y <- rowMeans(pred_temp, dims = 2)
    
    # Ensure directory exists before saving
    if (!dir.exists(dirname(target_path))) {
      dir.create(dirname(target_path), recursive = TRUE)
    }
    
    # Save the object
    saveRDS(pred_y, target_path)
    
    return(pred_y)
    
  } else {
    # If file exists, simply load it
    message(paste("Loading existing predictions for:", folder))
    return(readRDS(target_path))
  }
})

# Name the list for clarity
names(predsY) <- models_nums

p <- predsY[[1]]
d <- designs[[1]]
# prepare for plotting 
dfs <- pmap(list(p=predsY,d=designs,m=mods), function(p,d,m) {
  # Calculate row sums and keep it as a data frame
    p %>% 
    as.data.frame() %>% 
    mutate(richness = rowSums(.)) %>% 
    rownames_to_column(var = 'survey') %>% 
    select(survey, richness) %>% 
    # Join with the second object (design)
    left_join(d, by = 'survey') %>% 
    # Join with the third object (metadata)
    left_join(m$XData %>% rownames_to_column(var = 'survey'), by = 'survey')
}) 
```

# TRY WITH PCA 

```{r}
# --- 1. Global PCA across all dfs ---
prec_cols <- grep("^perc_", colnames(dfs[[1]]), value = TRUE)

# Stack all land-use data from all dfs for global PCA
all_landuse <- do.call(rbind, lapply(dfs, function(df) df[, prec_cols]))

# Fit global PCA
global_pca <- prcomp(all_landuse, scale. = TRUE, center = TRUE)

# Inspect variance explained
var_exp <- summary(global_pca)$importance[2, ]
print(round(var_exp, 3))

# Retain PCs explaining > 5% variance
n_pcs <- sum(var_exp > 0.05)
print(paste("Retaining", n_pcs, "PCs"))

# Global loadings — single source of truth for all models
global_loadings <- global_pca$rotation[, 1:n_pcs]
global_var_exp  <- var_exp[1:n_pcs]
print(round(global_loadings, 3))

# --- 2. Apply global PCA to each df (predict scores using global rotation) ---
add_landuse_pca_global <- function(df, pca, n_pcs) {
  prec_cols <- grep("^perc_", colnames(df), value = TRUE)
  
  # Project this df's data onto the GLOBAL PCA axes
  pc_scores <- predict(pca, newdata = df[, prec_cols])[, 1:n_pcs]
  pc_scores <- as.data.frame(pc_scores)
  colnames(pc_scores) <- paste0("lu_PC", 1:n_pcs)
  
  df <- df[, !colnames(df) %in% prec_cols]
  df <- cbind(df, pc_scores)
  return(df)
}

dfs_prep <- lapply(dfs, add_landuse_pca_global, pca = global_pca, n_pcs = n_pcs)

# --- 3. Main GWR pipeline ---
gwr_mods <- pmap(list(df = dfs_prep, mod = mods), function(df, mod) {
  
  vars   <- colnames(mod$XData)
  lu_pcs <- grep("^lu_PC", colnames(df), value = TRUE)
  vars   <- c(vars[!grepl("^perc_", vars)], lu_pcs)
  
  # Scale all vars including PCs
  df[vars] <- scale(df[vars])
  
  coordinates(df) <- c('X', 'Y')
  
  formula <- reformulate(termlabels = vars, response = 'richness')
  
  bw_adaptive <- bw.gwr(formula,
                        data = df,
                        approach = "CV",
                        kernel = "bisquare",
                        adaptive = TRUE)
  
  print('run the model')
  gwr_model <- gwr.basic(formula,
                         data = df,
                         bw = bw_adaptive,
                         kernel = "bisquare",
                         adaptive = TRUE)
  
  print('run collin diag')
  collin_diag <- gwr.collin.diagno(formula,
                                   data = df,
                                   bw = bw_adaptive,
                                   kernel = "bisquare",
                                   adaptive = TRUE)
  
  return(list(mod     = gwr_model,
              collin  = collin_diag))
  # Note: loadings live in global_loadings, not per-model
})

# --- 4. Build PC labels from global loadings (once, used in all plots) ---
pc_labels <- apply(global_loadings, 2, function(col) {
  dominant  <- names(which.max(abs(col)))
  direction <- ifelse(col[dominant] > 0, "+", "-")
  paste0(gsub("perc_", "", dominant), direction)
})

lu_pcs <- paste0("lu_PC", 1:n_pcs)

var_labels <- c(
  "tmean_breeding" = "Breeding Temp.",
  "prec_breeding"  = "Breeding Precip.",
  "hh"             = "Heterogeneity",
  setNames(pc_labels, lu_pcs)
)

driver_colours <- c(
  "Breeding Temp."        = "#e41a1c",
  "Breeding Precip."      = "#377eb8",
  "Heterogeneity"         = "#ff7f00",
  'cropland-' = 'goldenrod1',
  'urban+' = 'tomato4',
  'forest+' = 'forestgreen',
  'grass_shrub-' = 'springgreen2',
  'cropland-' = 'goldenrod4',
  "No Significant Driver" = "grey85"
)

gwr_theme <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title    = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle   = element_text(colour = "grey40"),
      panel.grid      = element_line(colour = "grey95")
    )
}
names(gwr_mods) <- c('1','2','3')
nm <- names(gwr_mods)[1]
# --- 5. Plotting pipeline ---
plots <- lapply(names(gwr_mods), function(nm) {
  
  gwr_mod <- gwr_mods[[nm]]
  
  gwr_model <- gwr_mod$mod
  
  gwr_sf    <- st_as_sf(gwr_model$SDF)
  
  tv_cols <- paste0(names(var_labels), "_TV")
  tv_cols <- tv_cols[tv_cols %in% names(gwr_sf)]
  
  dominant_drivers <- gwr_sf %>%

    st_drop_geometry() %>%

    select(all_of(tv_cols[tv_cols != "Intercept_TV"])) %>%

    rowwise() %>%

    mutate(

      max_tv       = max(abs(c_across(everything())), na.rm = TRUE),

      dominant_col = names(.)[which.max(abs(c_across(everything())))],
      
      raw_tv_value = cur_data()[[dominant_col]],
    
    # 3. Assign the direction based on the raw value
    direction = ifelse(raw_tv_value >= 0, "Positive (+)", "Negative (-)")

    ) %>%

    ungroup() %>%

    mutate(

      dominant_var = var_labels[gsub("_TV$", "", dominant_col)],

      dominant_var = ifelse(max_tv < 1.96, "No Significant Driver", dominant_var)

    ) %>%

    st_sf(geometry = st_geometry(gwr_sf))
  
  p_dominant <- ggplot(dominant_drivers) +
    geom_sf(aes(colour = dominant_var,shape = direction), size = 1.8) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = driver_colours, name = "Primary Driver",
                        drop = TRUE) +
        scale_shape_manual(values = list('Negative (-)' = 4,
                                         'Positive (+)' = 19), name = "Primary Driver",
                        drop = TRUE) +
    gwr_theme() +
    labs(
      title    = paste0("Dominant driver of richness - Atlas ",nm),
      subtitle = "Variable with highest significant |t-value| at each site",
      caption  = paste0("Global PCA loadings: ",
                        paste(paste0(lu_pcs, " = ", pc_labels), collapse = "; "))
    )
  
  p_r2 <- ggplot(gwr_sf) +
    geom_sf(aes(colour = Local_R2), size = 1.5) +
    scale_colour_viridis_c(option = "magma", name = "Local R²", limits = c(0, 1)) +
    gwr_theme() +
    labs(title = "Model Fit", subtitle = "Local R² from GWR")
  
  list(dominant = p_dominant, r2 = p_r2)
})

# --- 5. Plotting pipeline individual variables  ---
# --- Individual Variable Significance Pipeline ---
individual_plots <- lapply(gwr_mods, function(gwr_mod) {
  
  gwr_sf <- st_as_sf(gwr_mod$mod$SDF)
  
  # Identify variables based on your var_labels (excluding Intercept)
  vars_to_plot <- names(var_labels)
  vars_to_plot <- vars_to_plot[vars_to_plot != "Intercept"]
  
  # Internal loop to create a plot for each variable
  var_maps <- lapply(vars_to_plot, function(v) {
    
    tv_col <- paste0(v, "_TV") # The t-value column
    
    # Check if column exists in results
    if(!tv_col %in% names(gwr_sf)) return(NULL)
    
    # Categorize the relationship
    plot_df <- gwr_sf %>%
      mutate(
        sig_status = case_when(
          .data[[tv_col]] > 1.96  ~ "Significant Positive",
          .data[[tv_col]] < -1.96 ~ "Significant Negative",
          TRUE                    ~ "Non-Significant"
        ),
        # Factorize for consistent legend colors
        sig_status = factor(sig_status, 
                            levels = c("Significant Positive", "Significant Negative", "Non-Significant"))
      )
    
    # Generate the plot
    ggplot(plot_df) +
      geom_sf(aes(colour = sig_status), size = 1.2) +
      scale_colour_manual(
        values = c(
          "Significant Positive" = "#d73027", # Red
          "Significant Negative" = "#4575b4", # Blue
          "Non-Significant"      = "grey90"   # Light Grey
        ),
        name = "Relationship",
        drop = FALSE
      ) +
      gwr_theme() +
      labs(
        title = paste("Spatial Significance:", var_labels[v]),
        subtitle = paste("Based on local t-values (|t| > 1.96)"),
        caption = "Red = High positive influence | Blue = High negative influence"
      )
  })
  
  # Name the list elements for easy access
  names(var_maps) <- vars_to_plot
  return(var_maps)
})

individual_plots[[1]]

# --- View ---
plots[[1]]$dominant

plots[[2]]$dominant
plots[[3]]$dominant

print(gwr_mods[[1]]$mod)
```

```{r}
CWMs <- map2(predsY, mods, ~ {
  S <- rowSums(.x)
  (.x %*% .y$Tr) / matrix(rep(S, .y$nt), ncol = .y$nt)
}) 


p <- predsY[[1]]
d <- designs[[1]]

    as.data.frame() %>% 
    rownames_to_column(var = 'survey') %>% 
    # Now join with .y (the design list element)
    left_join(d, by = 'survey') %>% 

    # Join with the third object (metadata)
    left_join(m$XData %>% rownames_to_column(var = 'survey'), by = 'survey')
})
```
